title: Jubilant Turkish Beans Stew
description: A buttery, creamy stew of black beans with fragrant allspice, slow‑cooked in a copper pot for a festive flavor.
instructions: Rinse the dried black beans under cold water and soak them in a large bowl of water overnight, or for at least 8 hours.
Drain the soaked beans and set aside.
In a copper pot, melt the butter over medium heat until foamy.
Add the diced onions and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle the ground allspice and smoked paprika over the onion mixture and stir to coat.
Add the drained beans, vegetable broth, water, and salt, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender and the stew has thickened.
Remove from heat, stir in the chopped parsley, and serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.
